mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, conditions are overcast near the Military Ridge State Trail with a full moon overhead. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

The Wisconsin Department of Transportation is holding public meetings regarding the US 18/151 corridor study between Dodgeville and Fitchburg. They are seeking community feedback on initial design concepts during an in-person meeting at Mount Horeb High School on November 18 and a virtual meeting on November 19.

There is plenty to do in Verona, including trivia today at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, pizza and a pitcher at Lake Lou-ee, or trivia at The Bogey Factory.

In a report covering October 18 through October 24, police handled several incidents. Specifically, on October 25, a 40-year-old Verona man was arrested for O W I after he was discovered unresponsive in his vehicle at an intersection.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Chocolate Caramel Twist. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM.
